svg.title: The armory — my tech stack
svg.desc: A rotating radar with a C# core scans a grid of 24 technologies grouped as core .NET (C#, .NET 9, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, .NET MAUI, TypeScript), cloud and real-time (Azure, Azure OpenAI, SignalR, Key Vault, Redis, OpenTelemetry), data (SQL Server, EF Core, MySQL, SQLite, SSIS and SSRS, Table Storage) and web and DevOps (JavaScript, AngularJS, Bootstrap, Git, GitHub Actions, Copilot).
